subject: Proposition 1
object: O(h) has two inequivalent central extensions by Z_2, given by Pin(h) and Pin(-h)

subject: restriction of the Pin(h) and Pin(-h) extensions to Spin(h)
object: the extension given by (5)

subject: Cl(h) for even dimension m=2nu
object: Cl(h) is central simple with a unique, up to equivalence, faithful irreducible Dirac representation gamma of complex dimension 2^nu

subject: restriction of the Dirac representation gamma to Cl^0(h)
object: decomposes as gamma_+ plus gamma_- into two complex-inequivalent Weyl representations

subject: Cl^0(h) for odd dimension m=2nu-1
object: Cl^0(h) is central simple with a faithful irreducible Pauli representation of complex dimension 2^(nu-1)

subject: Pauli representations sigma and sigma composed with alpha of Cl(h)
object: they extend the Pauli representation of Cl^0(h) to Cl(h) with sigma(vol(h)) = i(h) id, and are complex-inequivalent and irreducible

subject: Cartan representation gamma of Cl(h)
object: gamma = sigma plus (sigma composed with alpha)

subject: commutant of the Cartan representation gamma
object: it is generated by gamma(vol(h))

subject: faithful representation gamma of Cl(h) with gamma and gamma composed with alpha complex-equivalent
object: existence and uniqueness up to complex equivalence, irreducible for even m and decomposable into two irreducibles for odd m

subject: intertwiner gamma_{m+1} of gamma and gamma composed with alpha
object: gamma_{m+1}^2 = -id and gamma_{m+1} anticommutes with gamma_mu

subject: representation gamma' of Cl_{k,l+1}
object: gamma' composed with iota is a representation of Cl_{k,l} in the same space

subject: Pauli representation restricted to Cl_{k,l} with k+l even
object: gives the Dirac representation

subject: Dirac representation restricted to Cl_{k,l} with k+l odd
object: gives the Cartan representation

subject: vector bundle associated to a representation gamma of G
object: is trivial if and only if an extension G' of G with a trivial associated G'-bundle exists

subject: classical Dirac operator (20)
object: maps spinor fields of type gamma to spinor fields of type gamma composed with alpha

subject: modified Dirac operator (21)
object: preserves the type of spinor fields

subject: pin structure on a hypersurface M induced by an isometric immersion into R^{m+1}
object: the bundle of Dirac (m even) or Pauli (m odd) spinors on M is trivial

subject: operator identity (partial x + x partial) applied to Phi in H_{m,l}(S)
object: (partial x + x partial) Phi = -(2l+m+1) Phi

subject: operator identity partial (partial x + 2) applied to Phi
object: partial (partial x + 2) Phi = 0

subject: sequence (41) of maps partial between H_{m,l} spaces
object: the sequence is exact

subject: space H_{m,l}(S)
object: decomposes as H'_{m,l}(S) plus H''_{m,l}(S), where H'' consists of x Phi for Phi in H'_{m,l-1}(S)

subject: spectrum of the Dirac (resp. Pauli) operator on the sphere S_m
eigenvalues +/-(l + m/2) of the Dirac (resp. Pauli) operator on S_m
object: each has multiplicity 2^nu times binomial(m+l-1, l)

subject: eigenfunction Psi of the Schrodinger transform of the modified Dirac operator on S_m with eigenvalue l + m/2
object: Psi is the restriction of partial(x Phi) to S_m, with Phi a harmonic polynomial of degree l

subject: eigenfunction Psi of the Schrodinger transform of the modified Dirac operator on S_m with eigenvalue -(l + m/2)
object: Psi is the restriction of x(partial Phi) to S_m, with Phi a similar polynomial of degree l+1

subject: Schrodinger transform of the modified Dirac operator
object: eigenfunction analysis for the spectrum and eigenfunctions of the Dirac operator on S_m

subject: spectrum of the Dirac (resp. Pauli) operator on real projective space P_m
eigenvalue lambda of the Dirac (resp. Pauli) operator on P_m
object: multiplicity 2^nu times binomial(|lambda| + m/2 - 1, |lambda| - m/2)
